“开玩笑，别紧张啊。”时笙轻笑了几声，“要想我们帮忙也不是不可以，不过……你得把龙玦杀了，顺便如果方便把那个叶清秋也解决了。”

仙帝：“……”

龙玦是南海龙族少主，杀了也没什么，但是那个叶清秋，她可是紫华仙君算出解魔界之难的关键人物……

杀龙玦的事，仙帝答应了，可叶清秋他却没答应。

时笙琢磨了好一阵都没琢磨出个所以然来，这叶清秋好像和仙帝没什么交集啊！

难道又是剧情君？

能杀一个是一个，时笙也就勉强答应了，叶清秋真要是那么简单就死了，她也不是女主了。

仙帝派人去办这件事，派去的人不是别人，正是枕风。

然而事情却没那么简单，枕风失败了，龙玦被人救走了。

时笙一阵头疼，修真世界的人都这么难对付？大爷的！

龙玦被人救走之后，也并不好过，枕风的战斗力那也不是吹的，他几乎去掉了半条命，如果不是叶清秋，他此时估计已经死了。

“枕风为什么要杀我？”龙玦神色阴沉的看着叶清秋。

“和我可没关系，他虽然喜欢我，可我一点也不喜欢他的。”叶清秋在龙玦脸上摸了一把，“我最喜欢的是你。”

龙玦厌恶的别开脸，就算这个女人救了他，可也改变不了她对自己做的那些事，他是绝对不会原谅她的。

叶清秋收回手，手掌来回翻了翻，“枕风这个人你比我了解，你觉得他会听谁的话？”

“仙帝？”枕风是仙界第一大将，向来只听仙帝的命令，如果有一个人能指使他的话，那肯定就是仙帝。

可想仙帝为什么要杀他？

龙玦脸色突然变了变，肯定是南海那边有变！

不行，他得回去！

南海打过来的时间比时笙想象中的还要快，而且仙界中不少人都被南海的策反了。

一时间整个仙界硝烟弥漫，自顾不暇。

南海早有准备，几乎没费多少力气就打到了仙帝的仙宫，密密麻麻的人将仙宫围得水泄不通。

“仙帝……怎么办？”陆章整个人都在抖，他们这些人常年好吃好喝，悠闲度日，哪里是那些常年战斗的龙族对手？

仙帝稳坐在龙椅上，望着下方的两人。

“两位……”

“仙帝，我的条件你可没完成，这不怪我不帮你。”时笙截断仙帝的话。

"You're just kidding, don't be nervous." Shi Sheng chuckled a few times, "It's not impossible to ask us to help, but... you have to kill Long Jue, and by the way, you can also deal with Ye Qingqiu if it's convenient."

Immortal Emperor: "..."

Long Jue is the young master of the Dragon Clan in the South China Sea, so killing her is nothing, but that Ye Qingqiu, she is the key figure for the Immortal Zihua to figure out how to solve the problem of the demon world...

The Immortal Emperor agreed to kill Long Jue, but Ye Qingqiu did not.

Shi Sheng pondered for a while but couldn't figure out the reason. It seemed that Ye Qingqiu had nothing to do with the Immortal Emperor!

Is he a plot guy again?

He could kill one person at a time, so Shi Sheng reluctantly agreed. If Ye Qingqiu died that easily, she would no longer be the heroine.

The Immortal Emperor sent someone to handle this matter, and the person sent was none other than Zhenfeng.

However, things were not that simple. Zhenfeng failed and Long Jue was rescued.

Shi Sheng had a headache. Are people in the world of cultivation so difficult to deal with?Uncle's!

After Long Jue was rescued, he didn't have an easy time. Zhenfeng's fighting ability was not to be underestimated. He almost lost half of his life. If it weren't for Ye Qingqiu, he would have died at this time.

"Why did Zhenfeng want to kill me?" Long Jue looked at Ye Qingqiu with a gloomy expression.

"It has nothing to do with me. Although he likes me, I don't like him at all." Ye Qingqiu touched Long Jue's face, "What I like most is you."

Long Jue turned away in disgust. Even if this woman saved him, she couldn't change what she did to him. He would never forgive her.

Ye Qingqiu took back his hand and turned his palm back and forth, "You know Zhenfeng better than I do. Who do you think he will listen to?"

"Immortal Emperor?" Zhenfeng is the number one general in the Immortal Realm. He always only listens to the Immortal Emperor's orders. If there is one person who can instruct him, it must be the Immortal Emperor.

Can you imagine why the Immortal Emperor wanted to kill him?

Long Jue's expression suddenly changed. There must be something changing in the South China Sea!

No, he has to go back!

Nanhai's attack came faster than Shi Sheng imagined, and many people in the fairy world were instigated by Nanhai to rebel.

For a time, the entire fairy world was filled with smoke, and it was too busy to take care of itself.

Nanhai was well prepared and reached the Immortal Emperor's Immortal Palace with little effort. The Immortal Palace was surrounded by a dense crowd of people.

"Immortal Emperor... what should I do?" Lu Zhang's whole body was shaking. These people eat and drink well and live leisurely all year round. Where are the dragon opponents who fight all year round?

The Immortal Emperor sat firmly on the dragon chair and looked at the two people below.

"You two..."

"Immortal Emperor, you haven't fulfilled my conditions. It's not your fault that I don't help you." Shi Sheng interrupted the Immortal Emperor's words.
